candidates.doc:
matchesTapOtherType checks if a card is a valid tap-other cost target.
The card must be untapped (the cost is tapping it), under the player's
control, and match the type filter. Compound filters join with underscore
(e.g. "legendary_creature" → Legendary + Creature; "blue_creature" → Blue
color + Creature type — see matchSimpleTapType's color qualifiers).
